reviews.hypothesis: HORIZON_EXTENSION — Macro regime information predicts medium-horizon (H-10, H-20) returns better than short-horizon (H-5)
reviews.reason: Tests H-3 macro features at longer horizons (H-10, H-20). Distinct hypothesis from Phase 14.5/15/16 which only tested H-5.
reviews.what_is_new: Horizon dimension not previously explored for macro features

reviews.hypothesis: MACRO_MOMENTUM — Rate of change of macro variables predicts returns better than macro levels
reviews.reason: Rate-of-change features are genuinely different from level features. Captures macro dynamics rather than macro state.
reviews.what_is_new: Dynamic macro features (rate of change) vs static levels

reviews.hypothesis: SECTOR_MACRO_INTERACTION — Sectors respond heterogeneously to macro regime changes, and this differential response is predictable
reviews.reason: Sector-macro interactions are distinct from uniform macro effects. Tests differential sensitivity across sectors.
reviews.what_is_new: Interaction of macro regime with sector identity

reviews.hypothesis: EVENT_CONDITIONED_MACRO — Macro regime effects are stronger on macro release days and high-volatility days
reviews.reason: Event-conditioned macro effects are distinct from unconditional macro effects. Tests timing of macro information.

reviews.hypothesis: PATH_STRUCTURE_REVISITED — Path structure features (drawdown, up/down ratio, vol-of-vol) predict at longer horizons (H-10, H-20) but not H-5
reviews.reason: Revisits path structure (H-1) with horizon extension. Partially overlaps with Phase 14.5 but tests new hypothesis.
reviews.what_is_new: Horizon extension for path structure features
reviews.concern: Path structure was classified FRAGILE — horizon extension may not resolve fragility

reviews.hypothesis: FUNDAMENTAL_HORIZON_MATCH — Quarterly fundamental features (valuation, leverage, profitability) predict H-60 (quarterly) returns better than H-5
reviews.reason: Revisits fundamental features with H-60 horizon. Distinct from Phase 12D/12E which tested H-5 only.

reviews.hypothesis: WALK_FORWARD_VALIDATION — Temporal instability of H-3 can be resolved with walk-forward (expanding window) validation
reviews.reason: Walk-forward validation is a methodology improvement, not a new information domain. Addresses temporal instability directly.

reviews.hypothesis: HORIZON_ENSEMBLE — Combining predictions across multiple horizons (H-5, H-10, H-20) produces more stable signals than any single horizon
reviews.reason: Multi-horizon ensemble is a methodology improvement. Uses existing information in a new way.
